tools.name: read_message_log
tools.description: Read recent entries from the Unreal Output Log. Captures Blueprint 'Accessed None' errors, asset loading failures, C++ asserts, and other runtime messages. Use this after PIE sessions or compilation to check for issues. This is a read-only tool.

max_lines.description: Maximum number of log entries to return (1-500, default 100)

clear_after_read.description: Clear the captured log buffer after reading (default: false)

tools.name: shutdown_editor
tools.description: Gracefully shut down the Unreal Editor headless or GUI process.

tools.name: find_unreferenced_assets
tools.description: Scan a content directory and find assets that have zero external referencers across the project. Useful for auditing orphan assets and disk space cleanup.

folder_path.description: Package directory path to scan for unreferenced assets (e.g. '/Game/Blueprints', '/Game/Materials', or '/Game/')

include_soft_references.description: If true, soft references count as referencers so assets with soft references will not be flagged. Default: true.

tools.name: inspect_uobject_properties
tools.description: Reflect and serialize all exported property values of a loaded UObject instance (e.g. DataAsset, Blueprint CDO, SoundBase, World asset) by object path.

object_path.description: Full object path or package path of the target UObject (e.g. '/Game/Data/DA_Config.DA_Config' or '/Game/Data/DA_Config')

include_inherited.description: If true, includes inherited properties from parent super classes. Default: true.
